verses.text: Iri ni ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri Zefaniya, mwene Kushi, Kushi mwene Gedaliya, Gedaliya mwene Amariya, Amariya mwene Hezekiya, ku ngoma ya Yosiya mwene Amoni, umwami w’i Buyuda.
“Nzorandura ibintu vyose biri kw’isi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Nzorandura abantu n’ibikoko; nkureho inyoni mu kirere n’amafi mu biyaga, hamwe n’ibigirwamana bituma umunyakibi atsitara. Igihe nzorandura abantu bose nkabakura kw’isi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze,

“nzoramvurira ukuboko kwanje kugwanya Abayuda, no kugwanya abantu bose baba i Yerusalemu. Nzorandura abasenga Bayali bose bazoba bagisigaye muri kino kibanza, n’amazina y’abaherezi basenga ibigirwamana,
bapfukama hejuru ku mazu, bagasenga inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru, bakongera bakunama bakarahira mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho , kandi bagasubira bakarahira mw’izina rya Moleki.
Nzorandura n’abo bose basubiye inyuma batakinsenga, hamwe n’abo batakirondera Uhoraho canke ngo bagire ico bamusiguza.”
Nimuhwekere imbere y’ Uhoraho Nyeninganji, kuko umusi w’urubanza rwiwe uri hafi. Uhoraho yarateguye ikimazi; yaramaze gutegura abo kugitanga.
Kandi kuri uwo musi w’ikimazi c’ Uhoraho , nzohana abatware n’abaganwa ari bo bahungu b’umwami, hamwe n’abo bose basenga imana z’abanyamahanga.
Kuri uwo musi nzohana abaja mu misi mikuru yo gusenga ibigirwamana, bakuzuza inzu z’ibigirwamana vyabo umuryano n’uruhendo.
“Kuri uwo musi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “induru izokwumvikanira kw’Irembo ry’Amafi, abantu baboroge bava mu gisagara gishasha, kandi ijwi rirenga rizumvikanira ku misozi.
Nimuboroge, yemwe ababa hafi y’utuguriro, kuko abadandaza banyu bose bakuweho, abashora ifeza bose na bo bakaba bahonye.
Ico gihe nzorondeza Yerusalemu urumuri, mpane abantu bose bidibamiye mu vyaha vyabo, bameze nk’umuvinyu ureremba hejuru ku mvuzo, bibwira ko Uhoraho ata na kimwe azokora, kiba kibi canke ciza.
Ubutunzi bwabo buzosahurwa, amazu yabo azosenyurwa. Naho bubaka amazu, ntibazoyabamwo. Naho barima imizabibu, ntibazonywa imitobe yazo.
Umusi uhambaye w’ Uhoraho uri hafi, uri hafi kandi uje wihuta. Amarira yo ku musi w’ Uhoraho azoba ateye agahinda, aho n’umuhizi mu ntambara azoboroga.
Uwo musi uzoba ari umusi w’uburake, umusi w’amarira n’imibabaro, umusi w’ivyago no guhona, umusi w’umwijima w’umuzitanya, umusi w’igipfungu n’ukwiraburanirwa,
umusi w’inzamba n’akaruru k’intambara, yo kugwanya ibisagara bizitiriwe n’iminara yo mu mfuruka zavyo.
Nzoteza ivyago amahanga, agende arajuragirika kurya kw’impumyi, kuko bacumuye k’ Uhoraho . Amaraso yabo azoseswa hasi nk’amazi, n’imibiri yabo ibore nk’umwavu.

Ifeza zabo canke inzahabu zabo nta na kimwe kizoshobora kubakiza, ku musi w’uburake bw’ Uhoraho .” Mu kururumba kw’ishari ryiwe isi yose iyo iva ikagera, izotongorwa n’umuriro, kuko azoshiraho iherezo mu buryo bwihuta ry’abantu bose bari kw’isi.
Nimukoranire hamwe, mwebwe nyene nimwiyegeranirize hamwe, yemwe mwa bantu b’ihanga ritagira isoni.

Mwegerane imbere y’uko itegeko ritangura kuja mu ngiro, imbere y’uko uwo musi ushika ukabatumura nk’uko umuyaga mwinshi utumura umuguruka, imbere y’uko ishavu rihambaye ry’Imana ribashikako, imbere y’uko umusi w’uburake bw’ Uhoraho ubashikira.
Nimurondere Uhoraho , yemwe abaciye bugufi bo muri iki gihugu, mwebwe mukora ivyo ategetse. Rondera ubugororotsi, rondera ukwicisha bugufi; kumbure muzozigamwa ku musi w’ishavu ry’ Uhoraho .
Gaza hazotabwa, na Ashikeloni hacike umusaka. Ashidodi hazokwamburwa abaho ku murango, Ekuroni na ho harandurwe.
Muzobona ibara mwebwe muba ku nkengera z’ikiyaga, mwebwe Bakereti; Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rirabagiriza, yewe Kanani, intara y’Abafilisitiya. Rivuga ngo: “Nzobatikiza, nta n’umwe azosigara.”
Intara yegereye ku kiyaga, izohinduka uburagiro, habe ibinogo vy’amazi y’abungere n’impongore z’imikuku.

Ico gihugu, kizokwegukira amasigarira y’abo mu muryango wa Yuda, aho ni ho bazoronka uburagiro. Mw’ijoro bazoruhuka baruhukire mu mazu yahebwe n’ab’i Ashikeloni. Uhoraho Imana yabo azobitaho, abasubize amatungo yabo.
“Narumvise ibitutsi vy’Abanyamowabu, hamwe n’agacokoro c’Abamoni, abatutse abantu banje, batera uruhagarara igihugu cabo.

None rero ndahiye ukubaho kwanje,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze, Imana ya Isirayeli, “Ni ukuri, i Mowabu hazoba nk’i Sodomu, Abamoni na bo babe nk’ab’i Gomora; ahantu huzuye ivyatsi n’ibinogo vyimbwamwo umunyu, ahantu hatazigera hasubira kugira abahaba. Amasigarira y’abantu banje azobasahura; abazorokoka mu gihugu canje bazokwegukira igihugu cabo.”
Iyo ni yo mpera bazohabwa kubera ukwishira hejuru kwabo, kuko bacokoye bagashinyagurira abantu b’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.
Uhoraho azobahindisha agashitsi niyasangangura ibigirwamana vyo muri ico gihugu. Amahanga yose yo ku nkengera z’ikiyaga azomusenga, bamwe bose mu gihugu cabo.
“Kandi namwe abo muri Etiyopiya, inkota y’ Uhoraho izobasogota.”
Azoramvura ukuboko kwiwe agwanye abo mu buraruko, arandure Ashuri, Ninewe ahasige ari umusaka, hagadutse nko mu bugaragwa.

Imikuku n’amasho ni ho bizoryama n’ibikoko vy’ubwoko bwose. Ibihuna vyo mu bugaragwa n’ibindi bihurira, vyose bizokwibera ku nkingi zaho. Uguhurira kwavyo kuzokwumvikanira mu madirisha yaho, mu miryango yaho hazoba ibibomoke, n’ibisenge vyubatswe mu masederi bizosigara bigaragara ata kibipfutse.

Ico ni ca gisagara cishira hejuru, cahoze gitekaniwe. Wahoze wishima uvuga uti: “Ndi uwuhambaye kurusha abandi! Nta gisagara na kimwe cogereranywa nanje.” Mbega ukuntu habaye umusaka, hasigaye hibera inyamaswa zo mw’ishamba. Abahaca bose bavuza uruhwa, bakahamama amashi.

headings.text: Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu bacirwa urubanza hamwe n’ayandi mahanga

verses.text: Uzobona ibara wa gisagara c’abacinyiza, bagarariza kandi banduye!
Nta n’umwe cumvira, kandi nticemera guhanwa. Nticizera Imana, kandi ntikinemera kumwegera.
Abaganwa bari imbere muri co bameze nk’intambwe ziroha; abatware baho na bo ni nk’amabingira y’umugoroba, ata kintu na kimwe asigariza ejo.
Abavugishwa baco nta co bubaha; ni abanyabinyoma. Abaherezi baco bahumanya ahera h’urusengero bakarenga ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho ibigirankana.
Uhoraho aba muri co ni umugororotsi, nta kibi kiri muri we. Uko bukeye aca imanza zibereye, kandi uko uwundi musi uje ntarambirwa, ariko ababi ntibaterwa n’isoni.

“Nahoneje amahanga menshi, nsenyagura ibihome biyakingira n’iminara yabo. Amabarabara yabo nsiga ari nk’ubugaragwa, ata muntu n’umwe akiyacamwo. Ibisagara vyabo vyarasenyutse, ni nk’ubugaragwa nta muntu aharangwa.

Yewe Yerusalemu, nariyumviriye nti: ‘Mu vy’ukuri uzonyubaha, wemere gutozwa indero!’ Maze ikibanza c’ubuhungiro bwabo kibone ingene kizigamwa, kandi n’ibihano vyanje vyose ntibibashikeko. Ariko na ho nyene bagumanye ishaka ryinshi ryo kwama bakora ibibi.

None rero nimurindire gatoya,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “mu gihe gito nzohaguruka ndabagirize. Namaze gufata ingingo yo kwegeranya amahanga, kwegeranya ubwami bwose, ngo ndabimarireko ishavu, ndabasukeko uburake bwanje bwose. Isi yose izotongorwa, irigitwe n’umuriro w’ishari ryanje.
Maze nzokweza iminwa y’ubwoko bwose, kugira ngo bose bashobore kwambaza izina ry’ Uhoraho , bamukorere bafatanye mu nda.
Abashwiragiriye hakurya y’inzuzi zo muri Etiyopiya, abanyambaza, abasabagiye banje, bazonzanira amashikanwa.
Kuri uwo musi, wewe Yerusalemu, ntuzokwongera kumaramazwa n’ibibi mwankoreye, kuko nzokura muri wewe ab’amanyama bishira hejuru, kandi ntimuzosubira kwishira hejuru ku musozi wanje wera.
Ariko nzosigaza muri mwebwe abitonda n’abaciye bugufi. Amasigarira ya Isirayeli azokwizigira izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Nta kibi bazokora; nta binyoma bazovuga; ururimi rubesha, ntiruzoba mu kanwa kabo. Bazorya baryame, kandi nta n’umwe azobatera ubwoba.”
Ririmba, mukobwa w’i Siyoni we; shira ijwi hejuru, Isirayeli we! Nezerwa, uhimbarwe n’umutima wawe wose, mukobwa Yerusalemu!
Kuko Uhoraho yagukuyeko igihano, yasubije inyuma abansi bawe. Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, ari kumwe nawe; nta kibi uzosubira gutinya.
Kuri uwo musi bazobwira Yerusalemu bati: “Ntugire ubwoba, Siyoni; ntureke amaboko yawe ngo adendebukirwe.

Uhoraho Imana yawe ari kumwe nawe, ni umuhizi mu ntambara, ashoboye gukiza. Azogira umunezero mwinshi ku bwawe, mu rukundo rwiwe, ntazokwongera kugukankamira, ariko, azokunezererwa akoresheje indirimbo.
Nzokwegeraniriza muri wewe abo bose bagandariye kubura ya misi mikuru yari yarashinzwe, ntuzongera guteterwa.
Ico gihe nzohana abo bose babacinyiza, kandi nzokiza abacumbagira; nzokoraniriza hamwe abajanywe mu kinyago. Nzobahesha ishimwe n’icubahiro mu mahanga yose aho babaye bababazwa n’ibiteterwe.

Ico gihe ni ho nzobegeraniriza hamwe; kandi ico gihe ni ho nzobatahana i muhira. Nzobahesha icubahiro n’ishimwe mu mahanga yose yo kw’isi, igihe nzobasubiza ubutunzi bwanyu mukavyibonera n’amaso yanyu,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

headings.text: Ubugarariji bwa Yerusalemu no gucungurwa kwaho
